To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the automated analysis of 3 images of the corneal endothelial mosaic, using 300 cells, is reliable, rapid and accurate, even for heterogeneous mosaic patterns and for mediocre quality images.
the automated tri-image analysis of endothelial mosaics of corneal grafts is rapid, reliable and accurate.
We developed an image analyser with tools for automatic error correction and can measure E.C.D. and perform morphometry of multiple zones of three mosaic images.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of a method of automatic image analysis for the analysis of the corneal endothelial mosaic.
the development of a new automated tri-image analyser of the corneal endothelial mosaic.
the development of an image analyser for automated endothelial analysis.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the tri-image analysis of endothelial cell density with the automated analyser is a reliable and rapid method of endothelial examination.
the automated tri-image analysis of endothelial mosaics is an efficient, rapid and reliable method, particularly for heterogeneous mosaics and for mediocre images.
the tri-image analysis of corneal endothelia is reliable even with heterogeneous mosaics.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
this new tri-image analysis method allows reliable and rapid measurement of ECD even for heterogeneous mosaics and for mediocre images.
tri-image analysis is a reliable and rapid method for endothelium analysis, particularly in cases of heterogeneous mosaic, and is a useful tool for corneal banking.
the tri-image analysis is the best option for automated corneal endothelial analysis.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the tri-image analysis is a robust method for endothelial analysis.
the automated tri-image analysis of corneal endothelia is a reliable method for ECD determination, and that this method is not restricted by image quality or by the mosaic heterogeneity.
the tri-image analysis is more accurate than the mono-image analysis and that the automated analysis is more accurate and reliable than the manual one, particularly when the mosaic is heterogeneous.
